verdict.rationale: Khoj's source is public in the khoj-ai/khoj GitHub repository, and a community member reports reading the code. Another community member identifies the license as GPL-3, an OSI-approved open-source license. Critics of the 'open-source' branding objected to chat relying on OpenAI, not to the code's licensing, so this is not a dispute. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of the license (e.g. a LICENSE file or docs page stating GPL-3) and first-party docs pointing users to the source repository.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
